t: The RS Bridge is able to interact with Refined Storage. You can retrieve items, craft items, get all items as a list and more.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/rs_bridge/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
RS网关可与精致存储模组交互。你可通过它提取物品、自动合成物品、获取全部物品列表等。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/rs_bridge/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your RS Bridge to a computer to make use of it!
将你的RS网关连接至计算机即可使用！
